description: A temporary lightweight stub implementation for the convex/react library, providing minimal scaffolding to allow the application to build before the real dependencies are installed. It includes mock classes and hooks such as ConvexReactClient, ConvexProvider, useMutation, and useQuery.

classes.name: ConvexReactClient
classes.description: A stub class representing a Convex client, initialized with a URL.

methods.name: ConvexProvider
methods.description: A React component that provides the Convex client via React Context to its children.

methods.name: useMutation
methods.description: A hook that returns a no-op asynchronous function mimicking a mutation call.

methods.name: useQuery
methods.description: A hook that returns undefined, simulating a query that does not fetch data in this stub.
